aquarium-salt.name: API Aquarium Salt
aquarium-salt.note: Often used alongside medication for ich.

quarantine-net-breeder.name: Lee's Net Breeder
quarantine-net-breeder.note: Useful for isolating a sick fish during treatment.

water-test-kit.name: API Freshwater Master Test Kit
water-test-kit.note: Tests ammonia, nitrite, nitrate, and pH — the first step for almost every water-quality issue.

beneficial-bacteria-starter.name: Seachem Stability
beneficial-bacteria-starter.note: Speeds up establishing the bacteria colony a new tank needs.

air-stone-pump.name: Tetra Whisper Air Pump
air-stone-pump.note: Adds surface agitation and oxygen during a water-quality emergency.

aquarium-decor-hiding-spots.name: Plecoceramics Aquarium Cave
aquarium-decor-hiding-spots.note: Breaks sightlines and gives weaker fish somewhere to retreat from aggressive tankmates.

algae-control-treatment.name: API AlgaeFix
algae-control-treatment.note: Controls green water and other algae blooms in freshwater aquariums.

activated-carbon-filter-media.name: Activated Carbon Filter Media
activated-carbon-filter-media.note: Removes tannins, odors, and discoloration from aquarium water.

liquid-plant-fertilizer.name: Seachem Flourish
liquid-plant-fertilizer.note: Comprehensive freshwater plant supplement to correct nutrient deficiencies.

aquarium-plant-light.name: NICREW Full Spectrum Planted LED Light
aquarium-plant-light.note: Provides the light intensity most live plants need to grow well.

liquid-co2-supplement.name: Seachem Flourish Excel
liquid-co2-supplement.note: Bioavailable carbon source for plants when CO2, not light, is the limiting factor.

root-tabs.name: Seachem Flourish Tabs
root-tabs.note: Root-feeding supplement for heavy root feeders like swords and crypts — liquid fertilizer alone doesn't reach the substrate.

aquarium-light-timer.name: BN-LINK Digital Outlet Timer
aquarium-light-timer.note: Keeps light duration consistent day to day — the single biggest factor in preventing algae from coming back.

uv-sterilizer.name: Coralife Turbo-Twist 3X UV Sterilizer
uv-sterilizer.note: Clears free-floating algae as water passes through it — worth it for tanks with recurring green water.
